data.name: Hotel Perla Central
data.address: Av. Ramón Corona 450, Zona Centro, 44100 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
Occupying a modern building in the central Mexicaltzingo district, this stylish hotel is within 15 minutes’ walk of Plaza Universidad light rail station, Guadalajara Cathedral and the sprawling San Juan de Dios Market.
Contemporary rooms feature flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi and desks. Suites add living rooms; some have whirlpool tubs or balconies. Room service is available 24/7.
Complimentary amenities include breakfast and parking. There’s also a sleek bar/restaurant and a fitness room.
